author: Gamers Nexus
description:
Sponsor: ID-Cooling Frozn A620 SLK on Amazon https://geni.us/Vc8Zi
We talk with Wendell about cool, older hardware that's still useful -- especially for self-hosting and bringing services into your own hands. The unfortunate reason DDR3 has once again found modern usefulness is due to the memory pricing crisis, perpetrated by AI companies -- namely, NVIDIA -- and the memory companies who supply them. We talk some cool, new-old hardware, including new motherboards with DDR3 and DDR4 support.
